name: current timestamp precision and update clause
text: CREATE TABLE t (created DATETIME(6) DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6));

name: SQLite autoincrement and nonbinary CHECK
text: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, value INTEGER CHECK (abs(value)));

name: group and order by all
text: SELECT a, count(*) FROM t GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL DESC;

name: qualify clause
text: SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM t QUALIFY rn = 1;

name: ordered aggregate and null treatment
text: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value), first_value(value) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY id) FROM t;

name: pivot
text: SELECT * FROM sales PIVOT (sum(amount) FOR quarter IN (1, 2));

name: unpivot
text: SELECT * FROM sales UNPIVOT (amount FOR quarter IN (q1, q2));

name: natural join needs no condition
text: SELECT * FROM a NATURAL LEFT JOIN b;

name: NUMBER uses the numeric type node rather than a generic name
lateral FROM item
text: SELECT * FROM t, LATERAL f(t.id) AS x;

name: star exclusion and renaming
text: SELECT * EXCLUDE secret RENAME value AS amount FROM t;

name: LIKE escape clause
text: SELECT * FROM t WHERE value LIKE 'a!_%' ESCAPE '!';
